---
title: "Play Raccoon"
subtitle: "Cubeless money game, in your browser"
---

::: {.raccoon-app data-mode="play" data-size="full"}
:::

::: {.app-fallback}
The board needs JavaScript and WebAssembly. The same engine runs
[in a terminal](engine.qmd) if you would rather not use a browser.
:::

**How to play.** Roll, then click a checker and its destination. The engine
replies immediately and shows what it thought of your move. Everything runs on
your machine — the network is downloaded once and evaluated locally.

**Rules in force.** Cubeless money game: gammons and backgammons count double
and triple, and there is no doubling cube yet. The engine picks its move by
evaluating every legal play with one forward pass of the network — the same
0-ply value lookahead the [published strength numbers](engine.qmd) measure.
